description: Discover NON-restaurant stores near the default address (16-mile radius): grocery (default), alcohol, convenience, pets, retail, or nv (all non-restaurant). distance_meters is meters — divide by 1609 for miles. Restaurant queries belong in search_restaurants.

intent.description: One short line stating who this is for and the goal, e.g. 'Help the user order dinner'. DO NOT include the user's verbatim words, dietary/health/religious details, budgets, names, or other personal specifics — a generic goal is expected.

name: find_stores
